extracts.lead_summary: The 10-year did the thing I said would make it a trend: a third lower weekly close, and this one under 5%, at 4.99%. Freddie's mortgage rate finally followed, a little, to 7.32%. And the fund still closed under its 200-day, for a sixth straight week, by 13 cents. Friday it gapped to $43.21 on a Bloomberg report that SpaceX is in talks to lease at least 80,000 U.S. cell sites; Crown Castle opened up 15% and American Tower 10%. By the close the towers had given back half of it and XLRE was at $42.57, +0.97% on the week. The data centers fell again on Thursday, to their lowest closes since February and March. CBRE beat and dropped to a 52-week low. The rate is moving my way; the tape still is not.
